title: Toolchain
description: The toolchain template file provided with the project request. AWS CodeStar uses the template to provision the toolchain stack in AWS CloudFormation.

allOf.description: The Amazon S3 location where the toolchain template file provided with the project request is stored. AWS CodeStar retrieves the file during project creation.
The service role ARN for AWS CodeStar to use for the toolchain template during stack provisioning.
The list of parameter overrides to be passed into the toolchain template during stack provisioning, if any.
